# systeam_oncall_schedule (Resource)

Manages an on-call schedule with participants.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the on-call schedule.
- `organization_id` (Number) The ID of the organization this schedule belongs to.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the on-call schedule is active.
- `participant` (Attributes List) Participants in the on-call rotation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--participant))
- `rotation_type` (String) Rotation type: DAILY or WEEKLY.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone for the schedule (e.g. 'Europe/Warsaw', 'UTC').

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the on-call schedule.

<a id="nestedatt--participant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `participant`

Required:

- `user_id` (Number) ID of the participant user.

Optional:

- `position` (Number) Position in the rotation order.
